The instant case arises out of a road accident dated RAKESH KUMAR KUMAR SINGH Date:
13.02.0218.

After investigating the matter, the police filed a SINGH 2025.12.04 17:31:36 +0530 Detailed Accident Report (DAR) indicating that a road accident had taken place and that one Khushbu who was traveling with her husband on the vehicle suffered injuries due to the fault of her husband namely Karan.
The vehicle number was HR55AA2137 and the same was being driven by Karan who lost the control and struck with divider.
The accident was attributed to the rash/negligent act of a driver of Karan.
PCR Van took the injured to DDU Hospital where she received treatment.
FIR No.59/2018 was registered and final charge-sheet was also presented before the Ld. Judicial Magistrate against driver Karan for offences punishable u/s 279/337 IPC, PS Palam Village.
2. On receiving of the DAR, the Ld. Predecessor conducted the proceeding.
Karan (driver) and M/s Ola Fleet Technolies Pvt. Ltd. (owner) did not file their reply.
The WS was filed by the insurance company.

On the basis of available material, Ld. Predecessor framed following issues:
1. Whether Khusbhu sustained injuries in a motor vehicle accident dt. 13.02.2018 due to rash and negligent driving of offending vehicle No.HR-55AA-2137 being driven by respondent no.1 Karan, owned by respondent no.2 M/s Ola Fleet Technologies Pvt.
Ltd. and insured by MACT No. 379/18 Khusbhu Vs. Karan & Ors.
Page No. 2 of 5

OPP KUMAR SINGH SINGH Date:
2025.12.04 2.
Whether the petitioner is entitled to claim 17:31:41 +0530 compensation, if so, what amount and from whom?
... OPP 3. Relief.
3. Claimant then examined herself by way of affidavit to establish the incident and the claim.
She relied upon the DAR, aadhar card and medical papers.
No further evidence was led.

The Ld.
Predecessor also recorded the statement of injured/ claimant about financial needs.
Thereafter arguments were heard.
The present judgment will dispose of the case.
4. Occurrence of accident is mentioned in the FIR.
Involvement of the offending vehicle is also mentioned so.
Even a charge-sheet was filed against the driver Karan.
In such circumstances, it cannot be accepted that the vehicle was not involved.
The driver and the insurance company have tried to impeach the credit of the witness but they have failed.
The cross- examination does not show any justification as to why she should be doubted on the point of accident, involvement of vehicle and rashness/ negligence.
Insurance company has not summoned the driver as a witness neither they have appointed any investigator.
Apart from the affidavit of injured, the FIR and the charge-sheet also support the claim of negligence/ rashness on the part of the offending vehicle.

KUMAR SINGH SINGH Date:
2025.12.04 17:31:47 +0530 5.
We have then to see as to what amount of compensation should be awarded.
6. The injured had not produced any proper medical bills to support any claim regarding compensation for treatment.
She has also not provided any material to show that she has suffered any loss of income due to the accident.
There is nothing to suggest that she was hospitalized for any sufficient duration.
The injury is simple in nature and therefore, nothing more can be given except awarding a nominal sum on account of the accident.
A lump sum amount of Rs.20,000/- is allowed in favour of the injured Khushbhu on account of inconvenience caused due to accident.
Liability 7.
Respondent Karan (driver) being principal tortfeasor driving offending vehicle in rash/ negligent manner is liable to pay compensation along with interest to injured.
The owner M/s Ola Fleet Technologies Pvt. Ltd. will be liable vicariously.
8. Though the vehicle is insured but the charge-sheet shows that Section 185 M.V. Act was invoked.
Clearly, driver Karan was under influence of liquor while driving the vehicle.
Neither the driver nor the owner has led any evidence to contest that drunken status of driver.

In such circumstances,
insurance company should not even be asked to first pay and recover when MACT No. 379/18 Khusbhu Vs. Karan & Ors. Page No. 4 of 5 the injured was none other than the wife of driver (the date of accident is 13.02.2018 and the record shows that divorce proceeding was pending even in the year 2024).

9. Whenever award amount be deposited, the same may be released to the injured in her bank account.

10. Let a separate Award be prepared based on the aforesaid calculation and directions, so that all the concerned persons can comply with the same.
 RAKESH KUMAR SINGH  KUMAR
